name: Figarium Soft Glass Library
purpose: A personal, human-curated library for finding paper figures and reusing editable resources.

designMethod.note: Used as a design process, not as a brand reference. Follow the user's blue-white frosted-glass screenshots, not Anthropic's visual identity.
designMethod.visualReference: User-provided screenshots on 2026-10-15: low-saturation blue-white atmosphere, small cream highlights, translucent glass trays, navy type, soft broad shadows and coordinated rounded corners. Reference artwork is not copied or redistributed.

typography.family: Locally hosted Manrope for Latin, PingFang SC or Microsoft YaHei for Chinese
typography.heading: Sans serif; no decorative italic, serif headline, or isolated color-accent word
typography.code: System monospace, only for actual code and paths
typography.body: Readable line height and bounded line length; Chinese-first labels

materials.atmosphere: Broad, static, low-contrast blue-white radial gradients with a restrained cream highlight; no animation or external background image.
materials.glass: High-white-opacity translucent panels, backdrop blur, a light inner highlight and a subtle blue-grey boundary; an opaque fallback preserves readability.
materials.scientificImages: Pure white opaque image surfaces with no image opacity, recoloring, blur or cropping.
materials.rounding: One coordinated radius family: controls 12px, cards 20px, large panels 28px.
materials.actions: Dark navy-to-blue gradients with legible white labels; avoid bright saturated buttons.

layout.desktop: [full-width top navigation] / [compact centered introduction] / [three resource categories] / [searchable gallery]
layout.mobile: [compact top header + downward-opening menu] / [compact introduction] / [categories] / [searchable gallery]
layout.alignment: Centered, single-column introduction; left-aligned collection content; centered figures inside complete white image mounts

principles: The collection is the visual focus; no featured-figure or recommendation module in the introduction.
Differentiate method figures, result figures, and tables with labels, icons, and semantic colors.
Keep scientific images complete with object-fit: contain; never crop axes, legends, or labels.
Method details expose one figure-specific PPT download, without diagram code or a duplicated paper bundle.
Preserve human selection, provenance, approximation disclosures, and local ownership.
Keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Navigation stays above the content on every screen size; never use a left or right sidebar.
Keep ample spacing, clear search and download actions, and text contrast over every glass surface.
Use the requested soft blue-white gradients and small cream highlights; no clay accent, serif editorial treatment or decorative motion.
